scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
storm/flood/fire/outage/facility-damage cancellation or suspension of emergency food distribution
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption identified in the bounded search window.

notable_exclusions.reason: Emergency food distributions were scheduled to proceed and North Shore Food Pantry distribution was explicitly reported as happening as scheduled; not a cancellation or suspension.
Virginia hunger-study coverage described food insecurity levels and demand, not an abrupt access disruption in one of the watch miss classes.
Pantry closure was in Ontario, Canada, outside U.S. scope and outside the hourly window.

coverage_notes.source_prioritization: Fresh local reporting and official/government sources were prioritized where surfaced.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is not the primary nationwide collector; production collection remains authoritative.
